description: Bike Cordon Counts is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Adelaide. Count of the number of bikes coming into and out of the city via major roads over a 12 hour period between 7am and 7pm. This cordon count (count of trips in and out of a particular area) is conducted in October each year. Coverage: City of Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher City of Adelaide. Its tags are Cordon count, adelaide, bikes, council, health. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
